# Geo Location

## Summary
Where a file was captured, with the convention that supplied the coordinates.

## Shape
`latitude` and `longitude` are plain numbers; `altitude` is a `QuantityField` so its unit is
explicit. `source` is a `CodedValueField` over the `geo-source` vocabulary — EXIF GPS IFD, iOS
Photos and Android Photos disagree about sign and reference conventions, so recording which one
wrote the values is what makes them comparable. `coordinates` and `place` are computed for display.

## Example
```ts
import { GeoLocationField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(GeoLocationField);
```
